entries.name: Documented Lua and Allegrex API names
entries.description: The local Lua packet lists apiRequest(), getEmuObject(), getAXObject(), AddHook, AddGPUHook, AddBootHook, AddVsyncHook, ReadMem8/16/32, WriteMem8/16/32, GetGpr, SetGpr, GetFpr, SetFpr, SetTextureHashMode, ToggleTextures, and RemapSavedata. It also names Patapon 2, Syphon Filter Dark Mirror, and Resistance Retribution under Official Lua Examples. API semantics, loading, and exact function-to-title mappings are not established.
entries.source: PSP Emulation - PS4 Developer wiki.pdf (oldid=297238); PSP Classics Configuration Files (Official) (oldid=295120)
notes: Packet: research/sources/psphd_ps4devwiki_lua_allegrex.md.
